content: Kin Abimeleki Sela I Ahe Tukan Wana Limiya
Abalahama Mamele wana abwakil bwabwalel i eguluwan yaka i tagilik i na labi Negeb, ge i minaa ga panuwa Gelal, Keides ge Sul ali hawawala.
Yaka gamagalau o wali wasa i pek lagona Sela bana i ba, “Nu te.” Inoke Abimeleki, panuwa Gelal ana kin, i hago ge i ba wana totuwalali elal hi na Sela hi en pwatanik elana ge i ahe tukan wana limiya.
Yaa bulin etega kenonou elana Yabowaine i masala Abimeleki elana ge i ba, “Owa nasi nu aliga, kaiwena yova toto u ahe iya toalolon.”
He Abimeleki nigeya ga alona Sela hi kekenu, inoke anana i lahe i ba, “Babala, nau nige gegi ya giginol! Age nasi alowau ge no gamagalau nu lopaaligama?
Abalahama no wasa i pem i ba, ‘Nu te Sela,’ yaka Sela al i ba, ‘Nu te Abalahama.’ He ya atena bubun, toto ya ginol nige tage nuwatu nanakina elana ge ya ginol.”
Inoke kenonou o elana Yabowaine i baek al Abimeleki elana i ba “Ee, ya atena nige nuwatu nanakina elana ge u giginol. Inoke nau te ya kaisewa ge nige alom yova ku kekenu ge tage nu gegi matawa.
He yova ya nu pek pasikal lagona elana. Tau o iya palopita, yaka ni awanun kaiwem ge nige nu aaliga. Yaa ebo nige nu pepek pasikal, he nasi nu aliga, alomwau ge wam gamagalau gegewel.”
Lan i gan mweluluga kekeisi, Abimeleki wana totuwalali bwabwatal gegewel i yogaagil. Inoke bugul gegewena toto i masal ana kenonou elana i wasaan elal, yaka hi lovakun nabi.

Inoke Abimeleki Abalahama i yogaan ge i baek elana i ba, “Hauna kaba pagan u ginol eliyama e? Nau nige bugul etega ya giginol panak eliyam, yaa wam ginol kaiwena alowau no gamagalau ha minaa lahi bwabwatana ya elana. Binimala bahi nu giginol ola!”
Yaka Abimeleki i nel al i ba, “Hauna wam puna ge u ginol ola o?”
Inoke anana Abalahama i lahe i ba, “No nuwatu tage panuwa ya gamagaliliyau nige etega Yabowaine i lolovakun-an, yaka lagou kaiwena nasi nihi tagapaaligau ge nihi oe.
He tunahot nu te Sela, alou tamama maisena, yaa hinameyau tomaha ona te ya alolonan e.

Yaka sauga Yabowaine i ba nam wana limi ana heniheni ya eguluwagil ge ya nononawanawa, yaka ya baek elana ya ba: Ebo u nunuwana-agau, yaka hauna labi elana ta nonoek, gamagalau wali wasa nu pek nu babaa, ‘Tau ya iya nu.’”
Yaka Abimeleki sipi, bulumwakau ge totuwalali loloyowanil bolau ge yowau i ahel ge i pek Abalahama elana. Inoke lagona Sela i pek pasikal elana.
Inoke i baek Abalahama elana i ba, “Matam u lipwapwati no abalogugui ana bwata nu kite, yaka labi etega nu hile ge nu na nu minaa.”
Inoke i baek Sela elana i ba, “He mani silba tausan maisena (1,000) ya pepek num elana am puluwawi ana abwabubun kaiwena, ge gamagalau gegewel nihi atena tunahot te owa nige gegi etega u giginol.”

He valila, sauga toto Abimeleki Abalahama lagona Sela i ahe tukan wana limiya, inoke baena Yehoba Abimeleki wana limi ana heniheni yowau gegewel lalgamaniliya i lokausan nige bosowailiya nihi liyan. Inoke Abalahama i awanun Yabowaine elana, yaka Yabowaine Abimeleki alonau lagona ge wana totuwalali loloyowanil yowau, i pwamolol bosowailiya al nihi liyan ge nihi ab.
